column1: Looks like it’s time to trim the fat
Digging a hole right through the glades
And by the time we get through
I’ll have no use for you
Won’t you be so proud of the mess
Running through the shallows with cottonmouth cypress knees
With a forearm tan and a bottle that’s where
I brought a woman friend home with me
For too damn long she couldn’t stand the heat
I had to choose  but she never thought she’d lose
But when it comes to the one
I love its plain to see
Yeah my paint job’s starting to peel
And there’s a crack in my windshield
But you can bet each time
Holy black water with sawgrass and citrus trees
